title: KellerVerificationReport
description: Output schema for Keller-Verify report.json findings array.

function.description: Demangled or MIR function name containing the checked obligation.

block.description: MIR basic block identifier (e.g. bb0, bb1).

kind.description: Machine-readable class of the obligation: bounds, overflow, divzero, path-insensitive, unsupported-assertion, unmodelled-panic, etc.

defect_class.description: Actionable defect taxonomy for FAIL findings.

file.description: Source file path where the function is defined.

details.description: Human-readable diagnostic description of the obligation and verdict.

witness.description: Concrete variable assignments satisfying the counterexample.

input.description: The source operand or local name plus MIR local (e.g. 'a (_1)').

symbol.description: MIR local variable or parameter identifier.

value.description: Assigned concrete value from the SMT model or constant evaluator.

witness_kind.description: Whether the witness values are uniquely pinned or one of multiple satisfying assignments.
